contea di ritrovamento: Monmouthshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Roman cast lead-alloy sealing. In plan the object is sub-circular, with a small spur protruding from the edge. The length from the tip of the spur to the opposite edge is 15.5mm and the width is 13.5mm. It is made from cast lead alloy with the decoration possibly stamped. The obverse has a bust facing right.
